familySummary.name: Governed diagnostic feedback
familySummary.publisherEstablishes: Exact product identity and artwork; Baker expressly claims handedness-specific tutor feedback and example shooting causes, while GunFun identifies diagnostic zones/tags. Printed labels may be publisher evidence, but catalog metadata alone does not establish a complete structured mapping.
familySummary.sczn3AlreadyRecognizes: Exact product identity, evidence capture, shot-observation reconciliation, SEC, preservation/reopen; registered geometry only where separately authorized.
familySummary.smallestMissingBehavior: Classify authorized observations into exact publisher-defined diagnostic regions and return only the corresponding publisher-supplied label, with provenance and confidence/failure state.
familySummary.evidenceOnlyToday: Record and preserve visible observations without diagnosing cause, technique, anatomy, or correction.
familySummary.authorityGap: Most GunFun catalog records establish a diagnostic tag or zone but do not publish the complete label/geometry mapping in structured authority. Baker describes example causes, but exact region mappings still require authoritative packaging from the target/Publisher Profile.
familySummary.subfamilyFinding: No. Right/left-handed layouts, humorous labels, bullseye versus silhouette presentation, and the Navy composition are profile variants. Navy qualification remains independently composed CF-12 authority.

familySummary.name: Commanded, cued, randomized, or timed drill orchestration
familySummary.publisherEstablishes: Exact product identity and selectable printed entities such as shapes, colors, numbers, rounds, or aim points, plus intended command/timed/memory use. Most product pages do not establish one canonical cue sequence, timing model, completion rule, or result.
familySummary.sczn3AlreadyRecognizes: Registered product, evidence capture, session state, backend-authoritative result, Universal SEC, preservation/reopen, and reusable scoring/challenge components where separately authorized.
familySummary.smallestMissingBehavior: Issue or accept governed cues, maintain sequence/timer/memory state, associate observations with the active cue, reconcile correct/late/missed/extra responses, and terminate by profile rules.
familySummary.evidenceOnlyToday: Record the target and observations; an instructor may conduct an external drill, but SCZN3 cannot claim it issued, timed, randomized, or evaluated that drill.
familySummary.authorityGap: Many Command products publish useful selectable shapes/colors/numbers but no canonical course. Primary links sample Simon-Says-style instructions; Fusion links a mutable external drill library. Each executable drill still needs a frozen, versioned rules profile.
familySummary.subfamilyFinding: One family with declarative modes: commanded selection, randomized cue, fixed timed string, and memory/repetition. CTQ composes CF-12 qualification; it does not create a new orchestrator.

familySummary.name: Decision discrimination and scenario state
familySummary.publisherEstablishes: Exact Good/Bad paired identity and the publisher's shoot/no-shoot designation for Dan, Dave, Jeff, and Rich products.
familySummary.sczn3AlreadyRecognizes: Exact target identity, evidence capture, observation reconciliation, session/SEC lifecycle, and preservation.
familySummary.smallestMissingBehavior: Govern which scenario identity was presented, the authorized expected response including no-response, response window, observation association, transition, and truthful result semantics.
familySummary.evidenceOnlyToday: Record observations against the exact product without inferring threat, legality, tactics, anatomy, or whether firing was correct.
familySummary.authorityGap: Baker establishes the pair membership and Good/Bad shoot/don't-shoot concept, but the catalog does not establish a complete digital course: presentation order, timing, shot limits, penalties, completion, or scoring.
familySummary.subfamilyFinding: No. Four character pairs are data instances of the same scenario-state behavior. Any future legal, tactical, use-of-force, or multi-scene judgment would require separate external authority and may expand the family later.

familySummary.name: Longitudinal progression
familySummary.publisherEstablishes: Baker establishes that the Bullseye Challenge target is used with its 20-page guide to track accuracy and advance from lower to higher levels over time.
familySummary.sczn3AlreadyRecognizes: Individual session evidence/results, shooter/session identity where governed, Universal SEC, preservation, and exact historical reopen.
familySummary.smallestMissingBehavior: Evaluate eligible preserved SECs against versioned level criteria, maintain current level and history, advance or hold by exact rules, and preserve the profile/version that produced each transition.
familySummary.evidenceOnlyToday: Preserve each target session independently; the shooter may consult the physical guide, but SCZN3 cannot assign or advance a level.
familySummary.authorityGap: The public product page establishes progression intent but not the guide's complete level criteria. The 20-page Baker guide is the primary rules authority and must be obtained, versioned, and licensed/approved for digital use.
familySummary.subfamilyFinding: No subfamily is established by one lineage. Architecturally this is a cross-session evaluator over SECs, not a target executor. A second independent progression fixture is required before claiming broad generality.

familySummary.name: Declarative collection/hand/path game state
familySummary.publisherEstablishes: Baker establishes Poker Wheel play, solo or multiplayer use, poker-hand formation, Royal Flush objective, and an instruction guide printed on the target.
familySummary.sczn3AlreadyRecognizes: Target identity, evidence capture, observation reconciliation, multiplayer/session primitives from existing target-shaped games, Universal SEC, and preservation.
familySummary.smallestMissingBehavior: Map observations to card/collection members, enforce hand size and turn rules, evaluate combinations/rank/ties, maintain player state, and terminate according to the exact printed game rules.
familySummary.evidenceOnlyToday: Record the impacts and preserve the evidence; the shooter may determine the poker hand manually from the printed guide.
familySummary.authorityGap: The product description is insufficient for executable details such as observation-to-card mapping, duplicate treatment, shot/hand size, turn structure, ties, misses, and completion. The printed guide must be captured as authoritative profile data.
familySummary.subfamilyFinding: Only collection/hand evaluation is evidenced by the counted products. The broader 'path' portion is not yet proven by this 69-offering denominator and must not be prebuilt. One lineage is insufficient to prove a universal game executor.

crossFamilyConclusion.finding: Current evidence supports one reusable owner for each remaining family, with no target-specific or publisher-specific executor.
crossFamilyConclusion.refinement: CF-16 evidence supports collection/hand state only; generic path-state generalization is not established by the counted population.
crossFamilyConclusion.validationCaveat: CF-15 and CF-16 each have only one product lineage, so a second authority-complete fixture is required before broad generality can be claimed.
